result.intro: gabe basically already planned it for you. free stuff, good light, tacos if you cave.

items.title: pearl at dusk
items.what: saturday ritual per gabe. ground fountains lit pink/blue, string lights in the trees, old brewery chimney behind. walk free, $12 tacos if you cave.
items.whyYou: made for your film brain — that roll 41 austin at 6:40pm reel. wet pavement reflections go crazy on portra.

evidence.caption: pearl at dusk. the ground fountains lit up, trees wrapped in string lights, a kid and a dog losing their minds in the spray, the old brewery chimney behind it all. saturday ritual. free to walk, $12 tacos if you cave #sanantonio #thepearl
evidence.sawLive: super chill at dusk, not packed — just a few people around the lit fountains and string-light trees. definitely good for photos, the pink/blue spray and wet pavement reflections pop against the pearl chimney.

items.title: mission san josé
items.what: long wall of stone arches, two rows, weathered 300 years. national park, quiet. go cloudy sunday morning like gabe + abuela did.
items.whyYou: quiet art time + texture for days. you like slow looking, this is it. and free keeps your $250 intact.

evidence.caption: mission san josé with abuela on a cloudy sunday. the long wall of stone arches, two rows, green bushes in front, weathered like it's been there 300 years because it has. free. national park. she lit a candle and then made me drive her to h-e-b. spare room in southtown is open, she WILL cook for you
evidence.sawLive: it's a long weathered stone wall with two rows of arches, green bushes in front, and a cloudy sky above. yeah, the texture and soft light make it look great for photos and quiet art time.

items.title: river walk 20-min dusk loop
items.what: stone bridge, trees lit purple/green, boat with red lights down the water. lena says 20 mins max, then go eat at the pearl after, don't eat down here.
items.whyYou: quick photo lap for your nyc subway-waiting eye — lights, water, people. then follow locals-only rule to pearl/southtown for food.

evidence.caption: took my out of town cousin to the river walk against my will. dusk is the only acceptable time: stone bridge, trees lit purple and green, a boat with red lights way down the water. still not a fan but I get it for 20 minutes. go eat at the pearl after, don't eat down here
